text:
This has to be one of the coolest open-source projects I’ve come across recently for making the web significantly more interactive. 👌

Imagine landing on any webpage and instantly being able to chat with everyone else currently browsing it.

That’s precisely what WebChat enables.

It automatically generates a dedicated chatroom for every website, allowing anyone with the extension to talk to each other in real-time on the same page.

I genuinely wish more people had this installed. It would make browsing the internet so much more engaging. :)

GitHub repo: github.com/molvqingtai/WebChat
first_comment_cta: Would you install an extension like this to chat with people browsing the same site as you? Curious to hear your thoughts! 👇
